task.claim:
Let L/K be a finite extension of finite fields of degree five, with
characteristic of K different from five. Let F be the K-linear q-power
Frobenius, q=|K|, and T=1+F+F^2+F^3+F^4. Then T(x) is the image in L of
Tr_{L/K}(x) for every x; ker(T)=ker(Tr_{L/K}), this kernel has K-dimension
four, and ker(Tr_{L/K})=range(F-1). This is the finite-field trace core of
frozen FROB control C5, not its full factor-kernel decomposition.
